validation.visual_review: Full-resolution generated sources inspected; refreshed browser board loaded 14/14 images; cheese and friendship final compositions inspected in browser. Candidate review only.

anatomy_review.scope: Full-resolution generated source scenes and resulting exports; human visual judgment, not objective certification
anatomy_review.date: Normal dog scale relative to sofa/humans; head supported on lap; plausible folded fore/hind legs; no paw stretched toward man.
anatomy_review.rain: No boot balancing or exaggerated sclera; lower frame shows four ordinary legs with one forepaw raised.
anatomy_review.cheese: Sleeping body rebuilt side-on with supported head and folded legs; no upside-down dangling limbs; cheese reaction retained visually.
anatomy_review.friend: No human-like grins, play-bow distortion or leash knot; separate dogs stand on plausible limbs and sniff noses.
anatomy_review.limitations: Generated scenes still have a polished synthetic photographic appearance; user acceptance not inferred.
